auth.token_lifetime: Docs example response shows expiresIn 19168 (seconds); re-login on expiry
auth.refresh: No refresh token; call POST /authentication/v1/authentication/login again with clientId, clientSecret, userAccessType=TOAST_MACHINE_CLIENT

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Toast Integration Partner program (Partner API account)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Docs: credentials are created by the Toast integrations team 'after your application has been reviewed and approved'
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Restaurant admin grants API access to the specific integration partner in Toast Web (partner access is per restaurant). Customer then supplies restaurant GUID / external ID. Fallback with no partner status: customer enables Toast Data Export nightly SFTP to our host (Toast Web > Integrations / data export).
access_requirements.cost_to_us: UNVERIFIED (no public fee found; partner terms are negotiated)
access_requirements.time_to_approval: UNVERIFIED (weeks to months per partner reports; no primary source)

sandbox.how_to_get: Issued by Toast integrations team after partner application; ws-sandbox-api host

rate_limits: UNVERIFIED (doc.toasttab.com returned 403 to WebFetch; rate-limit page not read)

events: labor/employee events (via Toast partner webhooks; exact list UNVERIFIED)

incremental_sync: ordersBulk with startDate/endDate on modified time (businessDate for single-day); pagination by page; used in repo by day/month windows

unified_api_coverage.apideck: no (not found on developers.apideck.com/connectors page text)
unified_api_coverage.nango: yes (https://www.nango.dev/docs/api-integrations/toast: user enters Client ID, Client Secret, API subdomain, Restaurant External ID; the Client ID must still come from Toast)

blockers: Multi-tenant Partner API requires Toast integrations team approval before any credentials exist; there is no self-serve developer signup.
Our existing Toast credential is Dabney's own machine client (TOAST_API_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, single restaurant GUID), not a multi-restaurant partner credential; it cannot be used for other customers.

existing in repo: ~/arthur/scripts/toast-api-monthly.js (machine-client login to ws-api.toasttab.com + ordersBulk, vault ~/.arthur/vault/toast.env names TOAST_API_CLIENT_ID, TOAST_API_CLIENT_SECRET, TOAST_RESTAURANT_GUID, TOAST_API_USER_ACCESS_TYPE)
existing in repo: ~/arthur/scripts/toast-nightly-sftp.sh and toast-sftp-rollup.js (Toast nightly data-export SFTP; env names TOAST_SFTP_HOST/USER/KEY)

existing in repo: ~/arthur/scripts/toast-admin-ops* and skills toast-admin-ops / toast-menu-item-write (browser scraping of Toast Web admin; TOAST_EMAIL/TOAST_ADMIN_PASSWORD names) - fragile, last resort
Interim route while partnership is pending: customer-side Toast Data Export to SFTP (needs customer to enable it) or Nango with the customer's own API client if the customer already holds one.
sources: https://doc.toasttab.com/doc/devguide/authentication.html - 'team after your application has been reviewed and approved' (Partner integrations credentials) and POST /authentication/v1/authentication/login with clientId, clientSecret, userAccessType=TOAST_MACHINE_CLIENT
